B2_calling_convention.defect: PyObject_Call(self->t_require_positive, S->snap, kw) passed the AuthoritySnapshot object as the ARGS argument. PyObject_Call requires args to be a TUPLE of positional arguments. require_positive_authority takes the snapshot as its FIRST POSITIONAL argument.
B2_calling_convention.consequence: the genuine positive path was unreachable, which is why no AUTHORIZED outcome could ever have been produced natively
B2_calling_convention.repair: args = PyTuple_Pack(1, S->snap); res = PyObject_Call(self->t_require_positive, args, kw)
B2_calling_convention.evidence: test_b2_positive_authority_callback_receives_a_positional_tuple asserts the snapshot arrives as args[0] AND that all six keyword parameters arrive by keyword, AND that the result is AUTHORIZED
B2_calling_convention.significance: this is the repair that makes HQ246-P1 provable

B3_traceback_and_exception_handling.defect: PyErr_Fetch(&pt, &pv, NULL) discarded the traceback slot, and the message was read from an un-normalised exception value with PyUnicode_AsUTF8 on a possibly non-str object
B3_traceback_and_exception_handling.repair: both sites now PyErr_Fetch(&pt,&pv,&tb) then PyErr_NormalizeException(&pt,&pv,&tb); the message is obtained via PyObject_Str(pv) with a defensive PyErr_Clear; and pt, pv and tb are all released. The decide ladder additionally clears the indicator defensively when reading the `.state` attribute, which may itself fail.
B3_traceback_and_exception_handling.evidence: test_b2_negative_authority_becomes_unknown_authority (a raising trusted callback becomes UNKNOWN_AUTHORITY), test_b3_exception_with_traceback_is_handled (2000 iterations of a nested raise, no leak or crash)

B4_malformed_replay.defect: a non-str relation_kind or target_use reached PyUnicode_AsUTF8, returned NULL, and that NULL flowed into PyUnicode_FromFormat / strcmp -- undefined behaviour and a crash path
B4_malformed_replay.repair: decide validates PyUnicode_Check on relation_kind and target_use before any conversion and raises an exact typed integrity error otherwise; validate_decision_replay validates the replay dict's relation_kind and target_use the same way before building the preimage
B4_malformed_replay.evidence: test_b4_malformed_relation_kind_raises_typed_error and test_b4_malformed_target_use_raises_typed_error (12 hostile values each, incl. a str SUBCLASS with an overriding __len__), test_b4_malformed_replay_decision_raises_typed_error (7 fields x malformed values), test_b4_replay_rejects_non_dict
B4_malformed_replay.standalone_reproducer: reproduction/hq247_b4_malformed.py exercises 108 malformed inputs across decide and validate_decision_replay; exit 0, no crash

HQ247_OPEN_001_leak.regression: no worse than the frozen base
HQ247_OPEN_001_leak.measurement_method: sys.getallocatedblocks() deltas after a 3000-call warmup, five repetitions, reported as median with full sample spread, on the positive and negative decide paths plus resolve_exact and validate_decision_replay
investigation: the three parallel lists (tmp_list of (key,dict) pairs, keys[], vals[]) and the PyList_AsTuple handoff were rewritten as a SINGLE sorted pass with adjacent-duplicate skipping and one explicitly-consumed PyList_AsTuple
that rewrite did NOT change the measured leak, which is itself informative: the parallel lists were not the cause

bracketing bisection with early-return probes placed the residual outside the sort and outside the append loop, and an early-return probe that DECREFs keys and vals immediately after the fill loop measured clean
probes that return before PyList_AsTuple appear to leak only because the probe itself does not release `sources`, so those probe readings are artefacts and are NOT treated as evidence
the residual is localised to the region that materialises the ordered `sources` tuple and its per-call ref-dict copies; it was not isolated further within this stage's budget
HQ247_OPEN_001_leak.impact: a bounded per-call memory leak in decide() only; it does NOT affect decision correctness, replay identity, custody hash or parity, all of which are byte-exact and asserted
HQ247_OPEN_001_leak.tests: test_open001_leak_is_measured_with_error_bars pins the trend so a regression that worsens it is visible, and deliberately does NOT assert leak-freedom while the defect is open; test_open001_clean_methods_stay_clean keeps resolve_exact and validate_decision_replay at < 0.05 blocks/call
